legal_authorities.section_22_application: Ordinary single-author literary works published during the author's lifetime: term runs to 60 years from the beginning of the calendar year following death. For death in 1894, the term expired at the end of 1954; public-domain status in India began 1955-01-01.
legal_authorities.author_death_evidence_note: Government Museums of India record identifies Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay as 1838-1894. Individual Wikisource title pages identify him as author.
